title: ModelSelectionMatrix
status: hand-written document contract, validated against the producer's own output; not a generated bridge family

support.question: Is this Agent/provider/model combination usable at all on this host?

states.supported: A declared canonical identity resolves for the combination.
states.unsupported: Nothing declares the combination. This is a catalogue statement, not a policy one.
states.unknown: The host cannot establish whether the combination is usable. Never rendered as supported or unsupported.

availability.question: Did a live source on this machine report the model, and when?

states.observed: A live source reported the model at observedAtUnixMs.
states.unobserved: No live source reported it. This is not a negative claim about the model.

credentials.question: Does this host hold a usable credential for the serving provider?

states.present: The owner states a credential for the recorded provider.
states.absent: The owner states no credential for the recorded provider.
states.unknown: The host cannot establish the credential state. Never read as absent.

execution.question: May this Agent run under the effective policy, right now, for this scope?
execution.owner: The effective admission policy, composed above the catalogue and stated per scope. Absent an owner, every scope stays undetermined.

scopeStates.allowed: The policy owner admits the Agent for this scope now.
scopeStates.blocked: The policy owner refuses the Agent for this scope now.
scopeStates.undetermined: No owner stated an outcome. Fail-closed, and never rendered as allowed.

execution.note: Direct and workflow turns are decided separately: the same Agent may be allowed in one scope and blocked in the other, and each outcome carries the scope it was decided for together with its own reason.

invariants: Every dimension carries its own state and reason; no dimension is ever collapsed into a single readiness label.
Both scopes are always present and are never merged, averaged or substituted for one another.
An unknown or undetermined state is never rendered as ready, allowed, present or observed.
An observation that could not be taken is reported as unobserved; it is never an empty available set.
No reason is empty: a state without a reason cannot be inspected.
